**Finding submitted: deviation (WARRANTY).**

- **Investigated:** § 5 (Contractor's representations, warranties and disclaimer), § 4 (ownership/acceptance), § 1 (performance standard), plus document-wide searches for "warrant", conformance/Specifications/defect/re-perform/workmanlike, and acceptance/refund mechanics. No conformance warranty, warranty period, or warranty remedy exists anywhere.
- **Why fallback fails:** § 5(a)–(d) cover only legal compliance, rights/authority, non-infringement and anti-bribery. § 1(b)'s "professional and workmanlike" language is a bare performance covenant with no duration or remedy, and § 5(e) disclaims all implied warranties, so no conformity obligation survives.
- **Cure:** one insertion after § 5(e) carrying only the four fallback elements — 90-day software conformance to documentation, 30-day Services warranty, and repair/replacement or refund of fees paid. Preferred 12-month/90-day terms, compliance-with-laws and no-malicious-code additions were not volunteered, and the existing disclaimer already preserves express warranties, so no carve-out edit was needed.
